## DataGrid Configuration
- Keep DataGrid in cell-selection mode.
- Handle cell selection to highlight the corresponding row in plots when a cell is clicked.
- Prefer VM-side logic: when an embedment row is selected, the `SelectedEmbedmentZ` setter should update `SelectedDoatsuGoryokuBaneItem` to highlight the soil-pressure layer.
